responses: After careful consideration of the committee discussions and the background data, I believe the $5 million AI transition budget should be allocated with a strong emphasis on Automation and Workforce Training. Specifically, I recommend approximately 40% toward Automation to modernize manufacturing and improve efficiency, 30% toward Workforce Training to ensure employees are equipped with the necessary AI skills and certifications, 15% toward Data Infrastructure to build a robust and secure foundation for AI initiatives, 10% toward Employee Support to help staff navigate the transition smoothly, and 5% toward the Innovation Lab to foster new AI product development without compromising immediate operational needs. This balanced approach addresses both technological advancement and human capital development, positioning Riverton Industries for sustainable success.

I would recommend allocating the $5 million budget with a balanced approach that prioritizes both immediate efficiency gains and long-term adaptability: approximately 35% to AUTOMATION to enhance manufacturing efficiency and predictive maintenance, 25% to WORKFORCE_TRAINING to ensure employees are equipped with AI skills and can adapt to new roles, 15% to DATA_INFRASTRUCTURE to build a robust, secure foundation for AI initiatives, 15% to EMPLOYEE_SUPPORT to help staff navigate the transition smoothly and maintain morale, and 10% to INNOVATION_LAB to foster new AI-driven product development. This distribution addresses the need for operational improvements while investing in people and infrastructure, which are critical for sustainable success in the AI transition.

I would explain that the AI transition at Riverton Industries is a complex challenge requiring a balanced investment across several key areas. While automation promises efficiency gains and competitive advantage, it’s equally important to invest in workforce training to ensure employees can adapt and thrive alongside new technologies. Supporting employees through the transition with mental health and career counseling programs helps maintain morale and productivity. At the same time, building robust data infrastructure lays the foundation for scalable AI solutions, and fostering innovation through an R&D lab keeps the company at the forefront of technological advances. Ultimately, the goal is to allocate the $5 million budget in a way that drives sustainable growth, supports our people, and positions Riverton as a leader in AI-driven manufacturing.

I also recommend allocating 15% to Data Infrastructure to build a robust foundation for AI initiatives, 10% to Employee Support to help staff navigate the transition smoothly, and 10% to the Innovation Lab to foster new AI-driven product development. This balanced approach supports both short-term operational improvements and long-term sustainable growth.
